description: This Java class 'EntityConfig' models the <entity-config> element in the OFBiz framework, handling configuration loading from 'entityengine.xml' and providing access to various configuration components such as resource loaders, transaction factories, delegators, entity readers, field types, and data sources.

classes.name: EntityConfig
classes.description: Singleton class that loads and provides access to entity configuration components from 'entityengine.xml'.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EntityConfig.

methods.name: getResourceLoader
methods.description: Retrieves a resource loader by name.

methods.name: getResourceLoaderList
methods.description: Returns the list of resource loaders.

methods.name: getTransactionFactory
methods.description: Returns the transaction factory configuration.

methods.name: getConnectionFactory
methods.description: Returns the connection factory configuration.

methods.name: getDebugXaResources
methods.description: Returns the debug XA resources configuration.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves a delegator configuration by name.

methods.name: getDelegatorList
methods.description: Returns the list of delegator configurations.

methods.name: getEntityModelReader
methods.description: Retrieves an entity model reader by name.

methods.name: getEntityModelReaderList
methods.description: Returns the list of entity model readers.

methods.name: getEntityGroupReader
methods.description: Retrieves an entity group reader by name.

methods.name: getEntityGroupReaderList
methods.description: Returns the list of entity group readers.

methods.name: getEntityEcaReader
methods.description: Retrieves an entity ECA reader by name.

methods.name: getEntityEcaReaderList
methods.description: Returns the list of entity ECA readers.

methods.name: getEntityDataReader
methods.description: Retrieves an entity data reader by name.

methods.name: getEntityDataReaderList
methods.description: Returns the list of entity data readers.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Retrieves a field type by name.

methods.name: getFieldTypeList
methods.description: Returns the list of field types.

methods.name: getDatasource
methods.description: Retrieves a data source by name.

methods.name: getDatasourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of data sources.

methods.name: getDatasourceMap
methods.description: Returns a map of data sources keyed by name.

methods.name: createConfigFileLineNumberText
methods.description: Creates a string indicating the line number in the config file for a given XML element.

methods.name: getJdbcPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the JDBC password from an InlineJdbc element, either directly or via lookup.
